text:
Iris: Rosette Systems wants a 5-week POC for their rosette-qlora-70b-edge variant. Key asks: hybrid tokenizer (BPE+SPM), 4-bit qlora vs GQA comparison, very large embeddings (8192-d) for a reranker, HSM-backed KMS, EU data residency option, and a strict p95 SLO (<=250ms). They also asked about per-call committed pricing and on-prem air-gapped option.
Caleb: Catalog check: we have rosette-70b-base in catalog but no qlora-edge variant yet and no hybrid tokenizer. Ask for their tokenizer artifacts (tokenizer.json, merges, tokenizer.model) and a 1k-line sample corpus to validate token->id mapping.
Nora: Embeddings: 8192-d is large. We can project from our 4096 hidden-state with a projection head but expected latency + cost will be significant (~25-35%). Recommend they try 4096 for POC unless reranker absolutely needs 8192. Ask which similarity metric they use.
Victor: Security: HSM KMS cross-account is doable but requires key policy + EU hosting for residency. On-prem air-gapped is possible but adds a setup fee and longer lead time. Also need to confirm whether customer data contains regulated identifiers.
Iris: Can someone run a rough perf on a 70b fp16 baseline and a 4-bit qlora to give Rosette ballpark p50/p95 for seq=1024 and seq=2048? They want to see GQA vs QLoRA tradeoffs.
Caleb: Running quick perf on staging base (no customer tokenizer yet):
```bash
# perf baseline
redwood perf --model rosette-70b-base --quant fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 96ms/token
# p95: 310ms/token

# perf qlora-4bit sim
redwood perf --model rosette-70b-base --quant qlora-4bit --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 110ms/token
# p95: 420ms/token
```
Caleb: Notes: QLoRA path adds a noticeable tail. GQA path tends to be better for long seq but we need to test their exact weights. If they require p95<=250ms at seq=1024 recommend dedicated pool + smaller batch + prefix caching. Logs uploaded RW-66190.
Nora: Embedding projection note: if we project 4096->8192 with a learned head, expect ~30% extra GPU time per embed. Option B: downsample to 4096 for POC and show reranker impact; that's faster and cheaper. I'll draft an eval harness for them.
Victor: Compliance note: EU+HSM+180d retention triggers enterprise addendum and legal review. On-prem air-gapped option needs ops lead time (~4-6 weeks) and a tech contact on their side for networking. I'll attach the HSM keypolicy template.
Iris: Action items: 1) ask Rosette for tokenizer artifacts, sample corpus, expected RPS, and whether inputs include PHI. 2) Caleb to run GQA vs QLoRA perf once they upload weights. 3) Nora to prepare embedding projection demo and cost delta. 4) Victor to draft security/KMS + on-prem estimates.
Caleb: Also flagged token id risk: their hybrid tokenizer uses high id special tokens (>65535) in some tooling. Our legacy packer assumes 16-bit in older paths; if they truly use >65535 we need a remap layer or upgrade the packer. I'll run a token-id-diff after they send tokenizer.
Nora: For pricing: I'll draft three options: hosted PAYG, 4-week committed dedicated pool (with p95 target), and private on-prem trial. Include embed-cost per vector for 4096 vs 8192 and example math for 100k/1M tokens.
Victor: I'll also include an explicit SLA note: automatic fallback to fp16 variant if p95 breaches for >10m window, and an ops playbook for promoting to dedicated pool. For on-prem quote, add setup fee + monthly support.
redwood-salesbot: Ticket RW-66190 created and assigned to #sales, #eng-ml, #eng-security.
Iris: Proposed POC plan to Rosette: week 0 artifacts + security QS; week 1 token-id diff + tokenizer fixes; week 2 perf runs (QLoRA vs GQA) + embed projection eval; week 3 integration + security sign-off; week 4 optional private deploy test; week 5 handoff & decision. Sending now.
Caleb: Once we get tokenizer I'll run the remap prototype if needed and post p50/p95 with their tokenizer attached (ETA EOD).
Nora: I'll bake sample embedding metrics so they can see retrieval delta with 4096 vs 8192.
Victor: I'll attach HSM + EU region checklist and estimated lead times.
Iris: Thanks team, will update after Rosette replies. :thumbsup:
